## About the Data

This database contains information on air quality across the globe, including particulate matter, greenhouse gases, and more, at hourly resolution. This data is available on Open Meteo, and is compiled from multiple sources, including the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) ENSEMBLE data provider. The data can be accessed through the [Open Meteo website](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/air-quality-api) or via API call under the CC BY 4.0 data licence. 

This data was gathered to support user investigation of a wide variety of environmental topics, including weather, air quality, climate change, flooding, and much more. Air quality specifically is an important topic for investigation, as poor air quality can negatively impact public health, safety, and long-term environmental well-being. Vulnerable communities in particular may experience disproportionate exposure to pollutants, and therefore disproportionate harm to their health. Factors like proximity to industrial zones, traffic density, and weather patterns are likely to contribute to disproportionate exposures. Analyzing and understanding variations in air quality helps policymakers, urban planners, and public health officials evaluate the effectiveness of current environmental regulations, and design targeted actions with the hope of minimizing health risks and promoting equitable environmental standards.

### Variables

::: {.table-container}
::: {.styled-table}

| Variable Name                  | Role     | Type        | Description         | Units         | Missing Values |
|--------------------------------|----------|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|----------------|
| `time`         | ID       | Datetime     | Date and time of day    | Datetime          | No             |
| `pm10`     | Target       | Numeric     | Concentration of particulate matter with diameter smaller than 10 µm (PM10) close to surface (10 meter above ground) | µg/m^3  | No |
| `pm2_5`  | Target    | Numeric     | Concentration of particulate matter with diameter smaller than 2.5 µm (PM2.5) close to surface (10 meter above ground) | µg/m^3  | No     |
| `nitrogen_dioxide`    | Target       | Numeric  | Concentration of the atmospheric gas nitrogen dioxide close to surface (10 meter above ground)  | µg/m^3  | No     |
| `us_aqi`    | Target       | Integer     | United States Air Quality Index (AQI) calculated for different particulate matter and gases individually. The consolidated us_aqi returns the maximum of all individual indices. Ranges from 0-50 (good), 50-100 (moderate), 100-150 (unhealthy for sensitive groups), 150-200 (unhealthy), 200-300 (very unhealthy) and 300-500 (hazardous).    | US AQI      | No             |

:::

Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) Atmosphere Data Store (ADS).
